content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Supermarkets and shopping centres should be allowed to open any Sundays and holidays at their discretion. For in this way, Sunday shopping days would be better spread out through the year. Also streets and shops would presumably be emptier as not everyone would be open on the same day. However then you'd have a worse overview of which shop is open on a given day.
What is the relation between "Supermarkets and shopping centres should be allowed to open any Sundays and holidays at their discretion." and "as not everyone would be open on the same day." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
